title: KebabPack
description: This Resource Pack replaces combat items (sword, pickaxe, axe, mace) with kebab referred icons.
body:
Turn your Minecraft weapons into the ultimate fast food menu! Tired of fighting with regular, boring tools and weapons? It's time to raid the kitchen and dominate the PvP or Survival world with a full kebab shop loadout! This resource pack replaces your high-tier gear with detailed, pixel-perfect fast food textures. Beat your enemies with a salad or rush them down with a massive kebab wrap!

⚠️ IMPORTANT INFO (PLEASE READ):
Netherite Only: This pack ONLY changes the Netherite tier tools and the Mace. It does not change diamond, iron, or gold tools.

In-game Warning: Inside Minecraft, the resource pack list might show this pack in red as "Incompatible". IGNORE IT! Just click "Yes" to force-enable it, and it will work perfectly fine without any issues.

🍢 What's inside the pack:
Netherite Sword ➡️ Kebab Wrap (Perfect for quick slices!)

Netherite Pickaxe ➡️ A Basket of French Fries (The crunchiest tool around 🍟)

Netherite Axe ➡️ Ketchup Bottle (Time to splash some red!)

The Mace ➡️ Salad (Smash them with greens 🥗)

⚙️ Info & Versions:
Made for Minecraft 1.21 up to 1.21.11+

Purely cosmetic, works perfectly on Vanilla, Realms, and all Multiplayer/PvP servers.

No mods required! Just drag, drop, and enjoy your meal.

Get ready to fight with the tastiest loadout in Minecraft history!
